title: Cross-surface coexistence catalog and safe upgrade playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a cross-surface 'coexistence catalog' that codifies compatibility guarantees between Redwood Runtime, Redwood API, client SDKs, and Console across LTS and stability lanes. Deliver a safe-upgrade playbook that defines rollout gates, automated preflight validators, canary cohort policies, and downgrade/rollback choreography. The catalog should include version pairing rules, supported upgrade paths (minor, patch, breaking), feature-flag fallbacks, and explicit per-surface test blocks required for a release to graduate from canary to GA.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog enumerates compatibility for each supported LTS version across runtime, API, SDKs and Console, including exact version ranges and incompatible combinations
Automated preflight validators (dry-run + schema checks + KV-cache smoke tests) implemented and runnable via release-tools with clear exit codes
Rollout gates defined as code: canary cohort size/time, success thresholds (latency/regression/error-rate), automatic rollback triggers
Playbook includes emergency rollback steps, communication templates, and runbook for data-plane migrations
Integration tests covering typical upgrade paths executed in CI and passing on staging clusters
Documentation published to Confluence and linked from Console release UI
